feed.title: NPR Topics: National
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR National News for reporting across the United States. Explore coverage of economic affordability, immigration, climate, environmental policy, justice and social trends.

entry.title: Western Kentucky welcomes data centers in hopes they make up for coal losses
entry.summary: In Kentucky's former coal country, data centers are a welcome sight as people hope they will bring in money.

entry.title: Federal authorities investigate cause of deadly plane crash in Florida
entry.summary: Nine people were killed Sunday when a Learjet crashed in South Florida. Federal authorities are investigating the cause of the crash that occurred during bad weather.

entry.title: Four types of House races to watch on election night to know how it might go
entry.summary: As polls close on Election Day and results start rolling in, these are some of the House races that will help explain how the midterms are unfolding.

entry.title: New restrictions at Texas Tech are changing what professors can teach
entry.summary: The rules have led to changes in course materials, prompted accusations of censorship and fueled pushback from faculty and students, including faculty departures, student protests and a federal lawsuit.

entry.title: A new cold war: hackers target fridges across the globe
entry.summary: NPR investigated cyberattacks on the digital devices that control industrial refrigerators, revealing the extent to which operational technology is exposed to damage and disruption.

entry.title: 'Messy,' 'divided' and 'scary': swing voters rate the country ahead of Election Day
entry.summary: One last check in with the Swing Shift voters before Election Day. All of them voted for President Trump. Now, they're rating his presidency and deciding who to support when he's not on the ballot.

entry.title: It's Election Day. Control of Congress is on the line, and what else you need to know
entry.summary: There are a lot of variables for how things will go today. Results will start to come in at 6 p.m. ET in Kentucky and Indiana, and then it will be off to the races.

entry.title: Connect250 creates a time capsule of life in America
entry.summary: We hear some of the results of StoryCorps teaming up with Morning Edition to connect listeners across America for a series of conversations about the country on the 250th anniversary of its founding.

entry.title: What to watch on election night and why exit polls don't tell the whole story
entry.summary: As Election night returns roll in, here's which House races to watch, when the results might start telling a story and why exit polls deserve a little skepticism, according to election analyst David Wasserman.

entry.title: Election expert confident about voting today, more concerned about what happens next
entry.summary: Millions of Americans have already voted in the midterms. So what's worrying election experts? Not so much what happens at the polls, but what comes after they close.
